title: TextEDA IR v0.18 — schematic view shard
description: The view (S1) of one print page of a board: where the symbols sit, how the wires run, where the labels and board ports are, and — on the module overview page — where the module boxes and module ports are drawn. A page may also compose a reusable module drawing (`module_place`) onto a static sheet template (`template`). This layer carries no electrical facts — it references the board's logical schematic by instance id, pin number and net id, and the two must agree. Lengths are integer nanometers, angles integer millidegrees (ADR-0006). The origin is the sheet's upper-left corner, +x right, +y down. See ADR-0035, ADR-0012, ADR-0067, ADR-0068.

format.description: Language version of the .teda file that produced this shard; see teda.md §13.

source.description: Source-file location: path relative to the project root plus an optional line number.

board.description: The board_id, resolved from the directory views/<board_id>/.

page.description: The print page id this view draws, resolved to views/<board_id>/<page_id>.view.teda. A print page is a drawing and print unit, not a logical partition.

sheet.description: Page extent. The source may omit it (default A4 landscape); without a template the IR always carries the effective size. Omitted when `template` is present: the template's size is then the page extent, and a page declares no size of its own (ADR-0068 D4).

template.description: The sheet template this page draws on, resolved from views/templates/<template_id>.sheet-template.teda. The template's furniture is static artwork and its size is the page extent. The view names ids, it does not define them (ADR-0068 D1, D3).

place.description: Where each component instance sits on the print page, sorted by instance id.

field.description: Optional manual positions for the Reference and Value fields, in symbol-local coordinates; rows are sorted by instance_id then name.

module.description: The drawn box of each module instance, on the module overview page; rows are sorted by instance_id. Omitted when the page draws no module boxes (ADR-0067 D7).

module_port.description: The drawn position of each module port, on the module overview page; rows are sorted by id. Omitted when the page draws no module ports (ADR-0067 D7).

module_place.description: Where a reusable module drawing is placed on this page; rows are sorted by instance_id then x_nm then y_nm. A placement draws the module's own drawing; it never states an electrical fact (ADR-0068 D4). Omitted when the page places no module drawing. A page that carries `module_place` draws no legacy `module` or `module_port` row.

junction.description: Named drawing-graph junctions, sorted by id. Junctions do not create schematic connectivity.

wire.description: Wire polylines, one per drawn run; several wires may belong to the same net.

label.description: Net name labels; the text shown is the net id itself, never an override.

port.description: Board port symbols; a port names an existing net, it never creates one.

note.description: Free text; canonical JSON has no comments, this is the substitute (ADR-0005 rule 8).

view_pin_ref.description: Board-level pin reference in numbered form: <instance_id>.<pin_number>, e.g. U1.5 or M1.U1.5. The view speaks the IR's normalized pin language (no pin names, no multi-unit shorthand), so the cross-check against the board is a direct comparison of the same strings.

view_endpoint_ref.description: A board-level pin reference, a module port reference (<module_instance_id>.<port_id>, e.g. M1.PORT), a drawn board port id, or a declared junction id. Coordinates are not endpoint identities.

place.description: The position and rotation of one component instance.

instance_id.description: Board-level instance id of the instance, e.g. U1. Must exist in the board's instances. An instance of a module carries the module's prefix (M1.U1); the view names ids, it does not define them.

x_nm.description: Symbol origin, x from the sheet's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Symbol origin, y from the sheet's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

rot_mdeg.description: Symbol rotation, clockwise positive, millidegrees; reduced modulo 360000. Omitted means 0.

unit.description: Which unit of a multi-unit symbol to draw. Omitted means unit 1.

field.description: A manual position for one visible symbol field. Coordinates use the symbol's local axes: +x right and +y up. Absence means the renderer chooses the automatic position.

x_nm.description: Field anchor x in symbol-local coordinates, nanometres. +x is right.

y_nm.description: Field anchor y in symbol-local coordinates, nanometres. +y is up.

module.description: The drawn box of one module instance, on the module overview page. The box is drawing-only: it says where a boundary is drawn, never what is inside it (ADR-0067 D4).

instance_id.description: Module instance id, e.g. M1. Must exist in the board's modules section; the view names ids, it does not define them.

module_id.description: The module this instance instantiates, e.g. charger-power. Must be the module the board binds to this instance.

x_nm.description: Box origin, x from the page's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Box origin, y from the page's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

width_nm.description: Box width; the box's own size, not the page's.

height_nm.description: Box height; the box's own size, not the page's.

module_port.description: The drawn position of one module port, on the module overview page. Drawing-only: the board file owns which net the port is bound to (ADR-0067 D5).

id.description: Module port reference: <module_instance_id>.<port_id>, e.g. M1.SYS_OUT. The port must be declared by the referenced module.

x_nm.description: Port position, x from the page's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Port position, y from the page's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

module_place.description: The placement of one reusable module drawing on a print page. The placement is drawing-only: it says where a module's own drawing is drawn, never what is inside it (ADR-0068 D4). The drawing's local bounds w × h are mapped into the page without scaling: a local point (u,v) becomes (u,v) at 0°, (h-v,u) at 90°, (w-u,h-v) at 180° and (v,w-u) at 270°, and the page position is then added.

instance_id.description: Module instance id, e.g. M1. Must exist in the board's modules section; the view names ids, it does not define them.

module_id.description: The module this instance instantiates, e.g. charger-power. Must be the module the board binds to this instance; its reusable drawing is looked up by this id.

x_nm.description: Left edge of the placed drawing, x from the page's upper-left corner. The position is the top-left of the transformed bounds.

y_nm.description: Top edge of the placed drawing, y from the page's upper-left corner, increasing downward. The position is the top-left of the transformed bounds.

rot_mdeg.description: Clockwise rotation of the placed drawing, millidegrees: a right angle only, because the page axes run downwards. Omitted means 0.

junction.description: A named view-only node in the schematic drawing graph.

x_nm.description: Junction position, x from the sheet's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Junction position, y from the sheet's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

wire.description: One polyline of one net between named pin, port or junction endpoints, optionally bending through given points.

net.description: The net this wire draws. Pin endpoints must be members of it in the board's nets.

from_pin.description: Start endpoint identity: a pin, a module port, a port this page draws, or a declared junction.

to_pin.description: End endpoint identity, with the same endpoint kinds as `from_pin`.

points.description: Bend points in the order they are traversed. Omitted means a straight wire.

label.description: A net name shown at a point on the print page.

net.description: The net whose name is shown. The label text is this id; it cannot be overridden.

x_nm.description: Label position, x from the sheet's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Label position, y from the sheet's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

port.description: The drawn symbol of a board port.

id.description: Port name; must exist in the board's ports section.

x_nm.description: Port position, x from the sheet's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Port position, y from the sheet's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

rot_mdeg.description: Port rotation, clockwise positive, millidegrees; reduced modulo 360000. Omitted means 0.

text.description: A free-text annotation on the print page.

x_nm.description: Text position, x from the sheet's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: Text position, y from the sheet's upper-left corner, increasing downward.

x_nm.description: x from the sheet's upper-left corner.

y_nm.description: y from the sheet's upper-left corner, increasing downward.
